rules.rationale: Halogen-dominated compositions are strongly ionic insulators with deep valence bands, giving the widest measured gaps.
d0/sp main-group oxides lack mid-gap d states, so the O 2p to cation s separation stays large.
Low mean Z means compact valence orbitals, weak spin-orbit coupling, and larger bonding-antibonding splitting.
Pnictides are mostly covalent small-gap semiconductors or semimetals, so they sit near the low end of the pool.

skills.hypothesis: Ranking by ionicity and d-shell closure recovers wide-gap insulators and transfers best when the pool is dominated by main-group oxides and halides; it degrades if narrow-gap mixed-valence or defect-dominated oxides are numerous.

rules.rationale: Source gives +6.07 index effect for high mean Z; by Moss inversion their loose valence electrons shrink the gap.
Metalloid dominance carried the largest source index gain (+9.23), inverted here to polarizable narrow-gap chemistry.
Balanced stoichiometry gave a modest source index gain but no strong covalency; retained as a weakly positive guard.
Only the second-lowest-confidence source relation (0.024), so applied at reduced magnitude to limit its influence.

skills.hypothesis: Low-confidence source index effects invert to band-gap effects under the Moss relation and enrich the surrogate only where they agree with known chemistry; the inversion fails if the source sign carries no transferable information.

state.lesson: Development seeds showed the domain-chemistry skill reaching a higher mean AUC (70.3 vs 65.2) with lower seed-to-seed dispersion, while the Moss-inversion skill matched it on final best but was more volatile and underperformed on several seeds. Since both remain single-digit-sample summaries, the revision keeps first-principles ionicity and d-shell chemistry as the deployed skill and retains the inverted source transfer only as a reduced-weight, lower-mass counter-hypothesis rather than discarding it.
state.revision_summary: Deployed wide_gap_ionic_insulator_chemistry, which won on mean development AUC with fewer collapses, keeping the halogen, d0-oxide, low-Z and pnictide rules intact. The counter-hypothesis skill now applies source-inverted effects at smaller magnitudes and lower confidence, drops the weakest-confidence lanthanide relation, and swaps the chalcogenide penalty for a balanced-stoichiometry guard. All conditions use exact public catalog field/value pairs; no target outcomes or candidate identifiers are used.
